snippet.title: Slay the Horde - Reveal Gameplay Trailer | Horde Survival Deckbuilder
snippet.description: Slay the Horde is a horde survival deckbuilder. Discover cards, build your deck and forge a game-breaking build in this fast-paced roguelike. Fight hordes of enemies while evolving your build into a screen-clearing engine of destruction.
